isolated_participant.instructions: Play Riichi Mahjong for only this seat. Choose one offered legal action. Tile IDs 0..135 have kind ID // 4: kinds 0..8 are 1m..9m, 9..17 are 1p..9p, 18..26 are 1s..9s; 27..33 are East, South, West, North, White, Green, Red. Physical IDs 16, 52 and 88 are red fives. Your hand and public_table are the only available tile information. Do not guess wall order or another hand. The engine scores, validates and resolves all moves.

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: pneuma.small
features: {}
abilities: {}
tools:
  _helper:
    description: Helper.
    parameters:
    - name: target
      type: string
      description: Target
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _x
        value: 1
    narrative:
      success: Rolled 1 for True.
  roll_once:
    description: Roll.
    parameters:
    - name: target
      type: string
      description: Target
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _x
        value: 2
    narrative:
      success: Rolled 2 for Ash.
  pick_one:
    description: Pick.
    parameters:
    - name: choice
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - a
      - b
      required: false
    - name: who
      type: entity_id
      resolve: participant
    - name: many
      type: entity_id_list
      resolve: entity_list
      min_items: 1
      max_items: 3
      unique_items: true
    - name: level
      type: integer
      from_state: participant.level
    - name: count
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 9
      default: 1
    pre_conditions:
    - 'true'
    effects:
    - publish:
        value: joined(x)
    narrative:
      success: Picked.
    metadata:
      tier: 1.5
procedures:
  tick:
    trigger: on_turn_end
    steps:
    - spatial_query:
        operation: path
        query:
          moving_entity_id: a
definitions:
  table:
    a: 1
narrative: {}
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
    key: state.actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
    key: entities

      1p..9p, 18..26 are 1s..9s; 27..33 are East, South, West, North, White, Green,
      Red. Physical IDs 16, 52 and 88 are red fives. Your hand and public_table are
      the only available tile information. Do not guess wall order or another hand.

      namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong

format: 1
id: pneuma.small
version: 1.0.0
label: Small
publisher: QA
mechanic_families:
  roll:
    parameters:
    - name: target
      type: string
      source: choice
      description: Target
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _x
        value: '{amount}'
    narrative:
      success: Rolled {amount} for {label}.
  pick:
    parameters:
    - name: choice
      type: enum
      source: choice
      enum_values:
      - a
      - b
      required: false
    - name: who
      type: entity_id
      source: gm_judgment
      resolve: participant
    - name: many
      type: entity_id_list
      source: choice
      resolve: entity_list
      min_items: 1
      max_items: 3
      unique_items: true
    - name: level
      type: integer
      source: state
      from_state: participant.level
    - name: count
      type: integer
      source: choice
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 9
      default: 1
    pre_conditions:
    - '{guard}'
    effects:
    - publish:
        value: joined(x)
    narrative:
      success: Picked.
    metadata:
      tier: '{tier}'
public_actions:
- name: roll_once
  family: roll
  description: Roll.
  configure:
    amount: 2
    label: Ash
  capability: pneuma.small.play
  state_predicates: []
  turn_statuses:
  - open
  writers:
  - dm
  reference_availability: included
  gameplay_resolution: engine_family
  deterministic_part: null
  gm_part: null
- name: pick_one
  family: pick
  description: Pick.
  configure:
    guard: 'true'
    tier: 1.5
  capability: pneuma.small.pick
  state_predicates: []
  turn_statuses:
  - open
  writers:
  - dm
  reference_availability: included
  gameplay_resolution: hybrid
  deterministic_part: Rolls.
  gm_part: Judge it.
private_mechanics:
- name: _helper
  family: roll
  description: Helper.
  configure:
    amount: 1
    label: true
definitions:
  left: &id001
    cost: 2
    tags:
    - a
    - b
  right: *id001
  list:
  - *id001
  - *id001
participant_artifacts:
- kind: player
  schema_id: pneuma.riichi-mahjong.player.v1
  schema:
    $id: pneuma.riichi-mahjong.player.v1
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - control
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 32
      control:
        type: string
        enum:
        - player
    additionalProperties: false
  entity_state_schema:
    type: object
    properties: {}
    additionalProperties: false
  initial_state_calculations: []
state_schemas:
- key: state
  schema:
    type: object
  references: []
  visibility: engine
- key: entities
  schema:
    type: object
  references: []
  visibility: engine
ui_surfaces:
- id: board
  capability: pneuma.small.board
  renderer: tactical_grid
  order: 7
  source:
    kind: state
    namespace: pneuma.small
    key: state.board
procedures:
  tick:
    trigger: on_turn_end
    steps:
    - spatial_query:
        operation: path
        query:
          moving_entity_id: a
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
    key: state.actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
    key: entities
  participant_control:
    field: control
    player_values:
    - player
    actor_participant_field: participant_id
  default_owner: gm
  isolated_participant:
    instructions: 'Play Riichi Mahjong for only this seat. Choose one offered legal
      action. Tile IDs 0..135 have kind ID // 4: kinds 0..8 are 1m..9m, 9..17 are
      1p..9p, 18..26 are 1s..9s; 27..33 are East, South, West, North, White, Green,
      Red. Physical IDs 16, 52 and 88 are red fives. Your hand and public_table are
      the only available tile information. Do not guess wall order or another hand.
      The engine scores, validates and resolves all moves.'
    observation_path:
    - game
    persona_path:
    - persona
    actions_path:
    - game
    - decision_actions
    public_observation:
      namespace: pneuma.riichi-mahjong
      key: state.public_observation
operating_guide: Run the small game.
